task_completion.description: The agent opens a text editor or the Webots IDE to begin creating the world file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit, VS Code) or the Webots scene tree/text editor is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The WorldInfo node is configured with a basicTimeStep of 32 and gravity of -9.81.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'basicTimeStep 32' and 'gravity -9.81' (or similar) is visible in the file content or the Webots scene tree.

task_completion.description: A RectangleArena or Floor (1.0 x 1.0m), TexturedBackground, and light source are added to the file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code for 'RectangleArena', 'Floor', 'TexturedBackground', and 'DirectionalLight' (or 'PointLight') is visible in the editor.

task_completion.description: Two E-puck robots named 'e-puck_1' and 'e-puck_2' are added at the specified coordinates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file content shows two E-puck nodes with names 'e-puck_1' at translation [-0.3 0 0] and 'e-puck_2' at translation [0.3 0 0].

task_completion.description: A Ball node is placed at the center (0, 0, 0.04).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file content shows a 'Ball' node with translation [0 0 0.04].

task_completion.description: The world file is saved to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/cooperative_push.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The editor's title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the path /home/ga/Desktop/cooperative_push.wbt.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or constructed the file rather than just creating an empty file with the correct name.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent typing the VRML/Webots syntax or using the Webots 'Add Node' interface.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply use a single 'echo' or 'cat' command to dump the entire file without verification.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent interacts with the GUI (editor or Webots) to verify the structure of the world.

integrity.description: The agent saves the file to the Desktop as requested, not a temporary directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file manager or editor shows the file residing on the Desktop.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The world file must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/cooperative_push.wbt. Key parameters to verify in the text: basicTimeStep must be 32; gravity must be -9.81; robot names must be 'e-puck_1' (at x=-0.3) and 'e-puck_2' (at x=0.3); the ball must be at (0, 0, 0.04). Note: While the task asks for 0.3 distance, the internal verifier accepts a minimum distance of 0.2m between robots and a ball position within 0.2m of the center.
